description: HTTP runtime module providing request/response pipeline, middleware execution, lifecycle integration, and adapter-facing abstractions.

business_logic_definition.note: HTTP-level invariants (e.g. ensuring a response exists, abort handling, middleware contract enforcement) are NOT business logic.

rules: All thrown errors MUST extend BaseError
Errors MAY represent protocol or contract violations
Errors MUST NOT encode application business rules
Events MUST NOT influence control flow
Events MAY expose identifiers and status codes
Events MUST NOT expose full request or response objects
Calling next() multiple times is a contract violation
Lifecycle state transitions MUST be enforced
Using the facade in invalid states is a CRITICAL violation
Adapters translate framework-specific APIs into HttpContext
Adapters MUST NOT contain business rules
Adapters MAY depend on framework libraries
Public contracts are stable by default
Facades are the primary public behavior surface
Internal implementations MUST NOT be exported

review_exceptions.exception: Middleware and pipeline logic are NOT considered business logic in this module
HTTP orchestration logic is allowed inside this module
